lowering_provenance.derivation: Set the matrix A in the published second-order block exponential to the scalar frequency w and lower the resulting companion to its four scalar entries.

sources.equation_claim: The twice-dimensional block exponential reconstructs the second-order oscillator flow, while cosine and sine are linear combinations of exp(+/-iA).
